why: The factory console's Projects table is the best reading-look table the owner has, and basalt cannot build it without escapes. It is 882 lines of its own code on TanStack Table (apps/console/src/components/project/table.tsx and cells.tsx in software-factory, on basalt-ui 2.29.0, whose tokens it reads). Of its ten columns, v3 covers five with a shipped kind (text, `spark`, `relativeTime`, two `meter`); five are `custom` today: a stacked bar of running, paused and ready work with a count, a duration with a toned trend arrow (twice), a lamp with an age, and a fraction with an age. Its quiet is the lesson: no cell hairlines, no header glyph but a help mark, group label rows with a count and no tint, figures right-aligned in mono, colour only where something is off. The owner on 2026-11-22: "the factory has [...] an interesting table where we can also maybe see and challenge if we could build something like that, how it displays the rows, or if we couldn't and what we want to learn from it or how we will then later on basically be able to improve that table in the factory as well".
what: The kinds and options a monitoring table needs in the reading look, proven by rebuilding that table in the playground with no `custom` column.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/table/core/kinds*.ts(x) and the cell parts they need, the reading-look rules in table.css
a playground page with a fixture of the same shape (31 rows in 6 groups), generated docs and the table reference of the basalt-design skill through its generator
must_not_touch: the header and width code from bench-table-rest
the software-factory repo: its console moves to v3 in its own Issue after 3.0 is published
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md. All in the reading look, each with sort value, filter, footer rule, priority and a `card` slot like the existing kinds. (1) `meter` takes segments: several toned parts on one track with the total beside it, each part named for assistive tech and in the tooltip. (2) `meter` shows a fraction ("455/472") beside the track when the column asks for it. (3) `number` takes a duration format ("30 min", "1.4 h", "2 d") and an optional trend: a direction arrow toned by a rule the column declares (lower is better or higher is better), with the comparison in words on hover and for assistive tech. (4) A fraction value ("11/12") toned by a threshold. (5) A cell may carry one quiet second value after the first (an age beside a lamp or a fraction), aligned as its own sub-column so the first values line up down the column. (6) `status` may render as a lamp, the dot alone, with the word for assistive tech and on hover. (7) A column header takes a help text, shown as one mark that opens a hint. (8) Group rows in the reading look: a quiet label and count, no tint, no rule but the row's own. (9) A quick filter as a segmented control in the toolbar for a small fixed set of named filters, if the view tabs from bench-manage-view do not already serve it; say which in the PR. What the code decides: whether (4) and (5) are options on `number` and `status` or a kind of their own.
reference: The factory console, Projects page (software-factory apps/console/src/components/project/table.tsx, cells.tsx, lib/project-table.ts; read them, do not copy them: they are 2.x). Columns: Project (name, optional tag), Now (stacked bar and count), Shipped 7 d (hourly spark and total), Last ship (age), Cycle and Queue wait (median duration and trend arrow, green down, red up, flat neutral), Production (lamp and age), Hygiene (fraction, amber under full, and an age), Plan (bar and fraction), Leads (bar and fraction). Groups: INFRA 3, TOOLING 10, PERSONAL 8, APPS 6, WORK 3, OTHER 1. Toolbar: search, a quick filter (All, Red, Hygiene gaps, Moving, Idle), Groups or Flat, Compact or Comfortable, Columns. Rows are 26 px in compact. A row is a link to the project page.
acceptance: The playground page draws all ten columns with shipped kinds and zero `custom` columns, grouped and flat, at both row heights, light and dark (layout test and shot)
Every toned mark has its meaning in text for assistive tech, and axe passes on the page
The phone projection of the page reads as cards with the same facts
Sorting works on every column by its value, not its text (tests)
out_of_scope: Changing the factory console. Live data. A new chart kind.
proof: Frames from `basalt-ui shot` of the playground page at 1800x1200 and 390x844, light and dark, attached to the PR, and the design reviewer run on them.
commits: Conventional, empty scope, packages/basalt-ui/** in its own commits. Never feat!: and no BREAKING CHANGE footer (docs/release.md). A changed or removed export updates migrations/areas and the generated docs in the same PR.
